title: A Simple Breakfast Table
description: Gather familiar breakfast foods, table objects, and small cooking words.
cardDescription: Gather familiar breakfast foods, table objects, and small cooking words.
focus: The clues identify objects and ingredients. They describe vocabulary rather than a meal plan or a recipe.
solvingTip: Look for food, a container, a utensil, or an action.
words: Warm breakfast dish made from oats
Deep vessel used to cook a breakfast porridge
Rounded dish holding an individual breakfast serving
Utensil used to eat a bowl of porridge
Dairy liquid poured over some breakfasts
Dried grape added to some breakfast bowls
Hard-shelled edible ingredient used as a topping
Bread browned and served at breakfast
Food commonly served boiled, fried, or scrambled
Device measuring a breakfast cooking interval
To move a spoon around a mixture

answerNotes.OATMEAL: Oatmeal names the breakfast dish here. The word can also refer to the ground or rolled oats used to make it.
answerNotes.RAISIN: A raisin is a dried grape. The clue identifies its original fruit rather than its size alone.
answerNotes.TIMER: A timer measures an interval. It differs from a clock used to show the time of day.
answerNotes.LID: The lid closes the pot’s top. It is separate from the body of the cooking vessel.

title: Making a Sandwich Plate
description: Explore a familiar lunch through bread parts, fillings, condiments, and serving objects.
cardDescription: Explore a familiar lunch through bread parts, fillings, condiments, and serving objects.
focus: The clues name ingredients and served food forms. Some answers describe parts of bread; others identify condiments and table objects.
solvingTip: Check whether the clue asks for an ingredient, a condiment, a bread part, or a serving object.
words: Baked food forming the outside of many sandwiches
Thin flat piece cut from a loaf
Food placed between pieces of sandwich bread
Dairy food commonly cut into sandwich slices
Leafy vegetable often placed in a sandwich
Juicy fruit commonly sliced for a savory sandwich
Sharp-tasting condiment made from a plant’s seeds
Preserved cucumber commonly served beside a sandwich
Soft mixture applied over a bread surface
Baked outer edge around a bread slice
Flat dish holding a prepared lunch
Utensil used to cut a sandwich
Outer covering keeping a packed sandwich together
Meal for which a sandwich is often served

answerNotes.FILLING: Filling names the food inside the sandwich. It is not an adjective describing how satisfying the meal feels.
answerNotes.SPREAD: Spread is a soft food mixture in this clue. The same word can be a verb for applying it.
answerNotes.TOMATO: Tomato is botanically a fruit but commonly used as a savory ingredient. The clue describes that sandwich use.
answerNotes.CRUST: Crust is the baked outer bread surface. It differs from the softer interior of the slice.

title: Pasta for Supper
description: Meet familiar pasta shapes, sauce ingredients, and objects used to serve a simple supper.
cardDescription: Meet familiar pasta shapes, sauce ingredients, and objects used to serve a simple supper.
focus: The clues identify food and equipment through direct meanings. Some words name a whole dish component, while others name an action.
solvingTip: Look for a food form, a flavoring, or an object used around the pot.
words: Food made from shaped dough and commonly boiled
One strip or strand of dough cooked as food
Liquid or semiliquid accompaniment served over pasta
Red fruit used as the base of many pasta sauces
Aromatic herb often associated with tomato sauce
Dairy food grated over many pasta dishes
Pronged utensil used for eating a pasta serving
Deep cooking container for pasta water
To let cooking liquid flow away from food
Rounded dish used for a pasta portion
Water vapor rising from a hot cooking pot

answerNotes.SPAGHETTI: Spaghetti names long thin pasta strands. The word is normally used for the food collectively.
answerNotes.GARLIC: A garlic bulb is divided into cloves. The whole bulb and one clove are different units.
answerNotes.DRAIN: Drain is a verb for removing liquid here. It does not name the opening in a sink.
answerNotes.BASIL: Basil is a fragrant herb. Its association with tomato sauce supplies the familiar food context.

title: Tossing a Garden Salad
description: Explore familiar salad vegetables, serving objects, and dressing words.
cardDescription: Explore familiar salad vegetables, serving objects, and dressing words.
focus: The clues identify ingredients by shape or use. They describe words rather than prescribe a dietary routine.
solvingTip: Check whether the clue names a leaf, a root, a dressing ingredient, or a tool.
words: Dish made from mixed prepared ingredients, often raw vegetables
Leafy plant forming the base of many garden salads
Dark leafy vegetable sometimes used in a salad
Long crisp vegetable often sliced into a salad
Small root vegetable often peppery in flavor
Root vegetable often grated or sliced for a salad
Juicy fruit used as a savory salad ingredient
Layered bulb vegetable added for a sharp flavor
Deep rounded vessel used to mix a salad
To lift and mix salad ingredients lightly
Seasoned liquid or mixture added to a salad
Fat used as one component of many salad dressings
Sour liquid used in dressings and pickling
Paired gripping utensil used to serve salad

answerNotes.DRESSING: Dressing is a salad accompaniment here. It does not mean clothing or putting clothes on.
answerNotes.TOSS: Toss describes light mixing in this food context. It is not a competitive throw.
answerNotes.RADISH: A radish is an edible root. The clue uses its familiar peppery character rather than one fixed color.
answerNotes.VINEGAR: Vinegar is an acidic liquid. The clue identifies the ingredient without specifying a recipe ratio.

title: A Casserole on the Table
description: Look around a simple supper through familiar dish parts, ingredients, and serving words.
cardDescription: Look around a simple supper through familiar dish parts, ingredients, and serving words.
focus: The clues name both food and the objects around it. Context distinguishes the vessel from what is inside.
solvingTip: Look for a container, a food ingredient, or an action at the table.
words: Baked mixed dish also named for its cooking vessel
Container used to bake and serve a casserole
Removable covering on a cooking dish
Enclosed heated appliance used for baking
Small grain used in many mixed supper dishes
One round green seed used as a vegetable
Tapered root vegetable cut into a mixed dish
Dairy ingredient used as a melted topping
Small bread fragment used on some baked toppings
Utensil used to serve a soft casserole
To offer a prepared portion to someone
Furniture around which a supper is shared
Food eaten together at a customary time
Person invited to share a supper

answerNotes.CASSEROLE: Casserole can name a vessel or the food baked in it. The clue explicitly allows that shared use.
answerNotes.CRUMB: A crumb is a small bread fragment. The singular clue asks for one fragment rather than a whole slice.
answerNotes.LID: A lid covers a dish. It is not the heated enclosure called an oven.
answerNotes.SERVE: Serve is the action of offering food here. The clue does not refer to starting a ball game.
